subject: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks

Team —

We’re at the point where the template work is real enough that we need a crisp go/no-go path and explicit owners for the launch-critical pieces.

Goal: ship v1 “RAG + agents” templates (Python + TypeScript) that are production-minded by default (retries/timeouts, streaming robustness, safe defaults, OTel hooks + dashboards, docs walkthrough + troubleshooting).

Proposed timeline (please sanity check):
- Internal beta: week of Feb 24
- Public docs + CLI + repo release: target week of Mar 17 (can slide a week if SRE/Obs needs more time)

Approval / resourcing asks:
1) Support coverage for beta + first 2 weeks post-launch
   - We need an on-point owner for template-related tickets (streaming disconnects, 401/429, collector misconfig, tool schema failures).
   - Ask: SRE + Support to commit to a lightweight oncall rotation for “template launch” (not 24/7, but same-day response for launch week).

2) KPI ownership and telemetry sign-off
   - PMs: can you confirm who owns the activation dashboard + definitions for “time-to-first-success” and template-tagged traffic?
   - We have engineering hooks ready to implement, but we need final event definitions and a privacy-safe tagging stance.

3) SRE/Obs readiness
   - Allison/Christine: need explicit sign-off on OTel attribute conventions (cardinality) + recommended alerts/SLO defaults included in the “observability pack” integration.
   - Also need guidance on what we consider “minimum viable trace completeness” for supportability.

Attachments:
- Quickstart-Templates-Launch-Brief-v0.6.pdf
- Template-Release-Readiness-Checklist-v0.3.docx

If we can align by EOW, we’ll lock the launch plan and avoid death-by-a-thousand last-minute changes.

Thanks,
Alex

—
Alex Martinez
Executive Sponsor, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference


From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 11:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks

Agree on pushing this into a clear go/no-go.

On KPI ownership: Hosted API PM team will own the definition + dashboard for “time-to-first-success” and adoption funnel. I’ll take point for the final spec, but I’ll ask Logan to be the analytics liaison once we agree on the event names.

Privacy: strong preference that template tagging is opt-in and does not include anything user-provided (no prompts, no file names, no tool args). Happy to review the header/tag proposal once Monica shares the exact shape.

Re: timing — Mar 17 seems feasible if the “template-tagged traffic” path doesn’t get blocked by proxies again. If it does, we should be ready to ship without telemetry tagging and backfill.

Nikhil


From: Allison Grant <allison@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 12:19 PM PST
Subject: Re: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks

From Observability side, I’m aligned with the goals and the timeline, with two conditions:

1) Attribute cardinality: we need a hard rule in the templates to avoid user-derived high-cardinality fields.
   - OK: model, route, status_code, template_version, deployment_mode
   - Not OK: prompt text, raw tool args/results, user_id, request payload bodies

2) “Minimum viable trace completeness”:
   - Every request must emit a top-level span and capture request_id / correlation_id.
   - For the RAG path, we need child spans for retrieval + generation (at least), and a tool span per tool call.

We can commit to a review + sign-off by Feb 28 if the implementation is ready by then.

Allison


From: Christine Wong <christine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 1:07 PM PST
Subject: Re: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks

+1 to Allison’s points.

On support coverage: I can commit SRE to:
- A launch readiness review (runbook, known failure modes, rollback plan) the week of Mar 10
- A designated SRE reviewer for the internal beta week (Feb 24)

But I can’t promise “same-day response” without a clear scope of what routes to SRE vs Support vs DevEx. Suggest we draft:
- an escalation matrix (what’s a Sev2 for template users?)
- a one-pager runbook for common issues (collector misconfig, streaming disconnect behind proxies, 429 backoff)

If DevEx owns first-line triage, SRE can be on the hook for infra/product issues that look systemic.

Christine


From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison@redwoodinference.com>, Christine Wong <christine@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 9:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks

Adding details so we can close the loop:

Telemetry/tagging proposal (opt-in):
- Header: X-Redwood-Template (value: rag-agent-python@<version> / rag-agent-ts@<version>)
- Also set a client-side attribute template.name + template.version in spans/metrics
- Default OFF; enabled via env var (REDWOOD_TEMPLATE_TELEMETRY=1)

This is specifically to measure template adoption + success metrics without touching prompt content.

For the escalation matrix Christine mentioned: I can draft a first pass and share with Priya/Dev (Support) for routing.

Monica


From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>
To: Christine Wong <christine@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Talia Benson <talia@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 2:26 PM PST
Subject: Re: Quickstart templates (RAG + agents): launch approval + resourcing asks

This is heading the right direction.

Decisions / next steps:
- KPI ownership: Nikhil owns KPI definitions + dashboard. Monica to implement opt-in header + span attrs once PM signs off.
- Observability sign-off: Allison to review attribute set + trace completeness by Feb 28.
- SRE support: We’ll do the escalation matrix + runbook so SRE coverage is scoped and not a blank check.

Asks:
1) Christine — can you nominate the SRE reviewer for the internal beta week by Tue (Feb 18)?
2) Allison — please share the “do/don’t” list for attributes as a short snippet we can drop into template README + code comments.
3) Nikhil — can you confirm whether “time-to-first-success” is defined as (first successful response) or (first app deploy) for v1? We need to instrument the right steps.

Talia — can you help schedule a 30-min go/no-go meeting for Mar 13 with this group + Support rep (Priya or Dev)?

Alex

Talia
